text:
@everyone 

We have digested the feedback over the past few weeks and have revised our plans for the upcoming sale! The most notable change is that the asset inventory will be split evenly between both chains. Below is a list of everything that will be available in the coming weeks and months. Please note that these products will be released in 'phases.' We will have a total of three phases and will launch each phase as the assets become available. Please stay tuned for further announcements on phase dates!


Tokenomics in ACTION!
,
We’re excited to kick off the first sale of its kind on our newly upgraded marketplace, and with it, we’re rolling out some key features from our tokenomics framework. 

Increased Buyback and Liquidity: For this sale, 20% of all non-COPI currency sales will go toward buybacks and liquidity—that’s double the standard 10%, further supporting the ecosystem. 

Boosted Rewards Pool: Additionally, 10% of all COPI sales will be funneled directly into the rewards pool, giving players even more ways to benefit while engaging with the marketplace. This is an important step in bringing our tokenomics to life and creating a sustainable marketplace for everyone. We look forward to your participation in this exciting new phase! 

For those that have not seen our tokenomics, you can view that here: https://copiwiki.cornucopias.io/gameplay/about-the-game/usdcopi-tokenomics/token-economy (edited)
Friday, October 4, 2024 at 4:16 PM

@everyone

We are pleased to announce that reward claiming is now LIVE! 

Here is a quick overview video that @Scruffy - QA Manager/Marketing put together to show the entire process: https://youtu.be/NQRucY7xZEM

While we have not seen any issues with the process, please open a support ticket if you encounter any problems with claiming!

Thanks!
